omm_stream.RejectedContribResponse

Response of a contribution that was rejected before the server acknowledged it, e.g. because of fields validation or a missing Ack/Error response within the timeout.

Available as lseg.data.delivery.omm_stream.RejectedContribResponse.

Syntax

RejectedContribResponse(message: dict)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
message dict Yes Message received from the server, or a dictionary with the 'Text' key for local rejections.

Properties

Property Description
ack_id Acknowledgement ID of the contribution, if present in the message.
debug Always empty.
error Text of the rejection reason.
is_success Always False, the contribution was rejected.
nak_code Negative acknowledgement code from the message, empty if absent.
nak_message Always empty.
type Always 'Error'.
